statement: DRD2 dopaminergic pathway is pathophysiologically relevant in FM
novelty_claim: First multi-evidence convergence analysis linking GWAS DRD2 signal to FM transcriptomics
test_strategy: Sensitivity analysis of GWAS-prioritized neural genes in GSE221921 PBMCs

metadata.score_note: A qualitative classification is used instead of a quantitative score. The quantitative score was removed because there is no objective formula. Qualitatively, this hypothesis is supported by robust cross-context validation (GWAS, transcriptomics, and clinical RCT evidence).
